purpose: Test whether causal XAUUSD execution, liquidity-window and volatility state improves candidate ranking after observed bid/ask costs

source_contract.volume_semantics: Dukascopy side-specific tick-volume proxy, not exchange trade volume or signed order flow
source_contract.join: exact candidate timestamp equals feature available_at; nearest and future joins forbidden

rolling_semantics.4bars: current and prior completed bars; approximately one traded hour
rolling_semantics.16bars: current and prior completed bars; approximately four traded hours
rolling_semantics.96bars: completed traded bars; approximately one traded day
rolling_semantics.480bars: completed traded bars; approximately five traded days
rolling_semantics.1920bars: completed traded bars; approximately twenty traded days

fixed_utc_liquidity_windows.disclosure: Descriptive liquidity windows, not official exchange sessions; deliberately fixed in UTC and not DST-adjusted

feature_contract.session_range_reset: UTC date plus fixed liquidity-window membership
feature_contract.missing_policy: Preserve nulls; model imputation is fitted inside each training fold only

evaluation_contract.purge: actual executable target exit must precede calibration or test boundary
evaluation_contract.calibration: latest 20 percent of each prior chronological fold after purge
evaluation_contract.selection_threshold: 80th percentile of scores in the prior calibration slice
evaluation_contract.fit_weighting: average inverse target-interval concurrency normalized to mean one
evaluation_contract.uncertainty: calendar-week block bootstrap with 500 registered samples and seed 42
evaluation_contract.direction_reporting: BUY and SELL separately plus combined

models.execution_only_ridge: 29 execution-state features, fold-local median imputation, scaling, Ridge alpha 10
models.technical_only_ridge_control: existing 33 features, fold-local median imputation, scaling, Ridge alpha 10
models.technical_plus_execution_ridge: existing 33 plus 29 execution features, same Ridge pipeline
models.technical_plus_execution_xgboost: same fixed shallow XGBoost with execution features

evaluation_contract.cost_stress_method: Do not refit scores; subtract incremental two-sided slippage from each realized target using executable entry
primary_development_gates: rank-IC lower 95 percent bound above zero
selected base-cost return lower 95 percent bound above zero
selected excess over all candidates lower 95 percent bound above zero
positive selected base-cost return in at least three test folds
paired selected-return improvement over matched control lower 95 percent bound above zero
selected return at 0.25 points slippage per side lower 95 percent bound above zero
at least one separately eligible direction
direction_eligibility: direction rank-IC lower 95 percent bound above zero
direction selected return at 0.25 points slippage per side lower 95 percent bound above zero
selected candidates represented in at least 50 calendar weeks

decision_rule.pass: All primary gates pass for an eligible execution-state model; result remains development-contaminated and may only register a new prospective shadow hypothesis
decision_rule.fail: Preserve REJECT_EXECUTION_STATE_MODELS; create no model artifact, runtime score, approval rule or Telegram behavior

change_rule: Any source, timing, feature, window, target, model, cost stress, threshold, gate or direction rule change requires a new contract version before affected results are inspected.
